description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of the number of matches across different categories, labeled 0 through 6. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a category of matches. The slice labeled “6” is light blue and represents 27.20% (8006) of the total. The slice labeled “5” is a darker blue and represents 10.4% (3043). A light green slice represents 6.2% (1810) for category “4”, while a green slice represents 6.8% (2002) for category “3”. A yellow slice represents 13.3% (3910) for category “1”, and another yellow slice represents 13.8% (4046) for category “0”. Finally, a light grey slice represents 22.4% (6583) for category “2”. Percentage labels and corresponding counts are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, but the categories are directly labeled on the chart.
